scene: The cheerful cook hands you skewers of hot, glazed rice cakes.
picture: Flat side view on wooden planks. Far left, a rope ladder hangs down from above. Left, a smiling racoon cook tends his steaming snack cart. Centre, the broad Pacific Islander player holds steaming skewers in one hand, ukulele under his arm. Right stands an illuminated tea lantern, and far right a dragon gondola rocks.
shown: wooden ukulele tucked securely under your arm in the centre
a carved dragon gondola moored to a post on the far right
a swinging rope ladder rising upward toward high platforms on the far left
